senses.gloss: c. (b. h. pr. n. Gehinnom, Gehenna, a glen to the south of Jerusalem where Molokh was worshipped; whence place of punishment of the wicked in the hereafter, hell, opp. גן עדן paradise.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 19a:5">Erub. 19ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Sukkah 32b:2">Succ. 32ᵇ</cite> <he>שתי תמרות … וזו היא פתחה של ג׳</he> two palm-trees are in the Valley of Ben Hinnom … and this is the entrance to Gehenna.
<cite ref="Sotah 4b:9">Sot. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>דינה של ג׳</he> future punishment.
<cite ref="Yoma 72b:13">Yoma 72ᵇ</cite> <he>לא תירתו תרתי ג׳</he> be not the heirs of two G. (here and hereafter, by laborious study of the Law without living up to its requirements).
